g.text: HOT PREHEAT TRAIN & ATMOSPHERIC HEATER H-101
1. H-101: 2-cell cabin, 8 parallel passes (convection then radiant); one pass shown typical (FIC-1011..1018).
2. TDIC-1019 balances pass outlet temperatures by biasing pass flow set points, total flow held.
3. COT TIC-1020 cascades to fuel gas pressure PIC-1021; O2 trim AIC-1022 on FD fan vanes.
4. Stream numbers (diamonds) refer to H&MB CFU-000-PR-HMB-001; data from design case, normal operation.
5. Pressures bar(g) unless noted. Pumps A/B are 2 x 100 %; only duty pump shown.
